title: CleanCodeGatesBarrier
description: What `gates.cjs barrier` writes to <out>/barrier.json (contract §5): every selected tier, run at the candidate tree under its bound (or its pass there reused from the cache), with each red suite classified against the same tier at base. Every array is sorted by code unit (tiers by id, suites and lists by file), except cleanup, which is in the order the cleanups ran.

change.description: invalid: the working tree's config is broken (key `config`), so its additions are ignored and the base's instruments run.

isolation.description: shared-dev when any tier that ran declares it, else ephemeral when any does, else null.

status.description: red when any tier failed; else not-run when any tier is not-run for a reason other than empty-scope; else pass. No tiers declared exits 3 and writes no report.

tiers.description: <tier id> → { candidate_ms, base_ms, rerun_ms, cleanup_ms }, absent sides omitted. The only durations in the report.

whole_run.description: Where a change-selected tier's whole suite runs, as declared; null for a whole tier.

whole.description: True under --whole, whether the tier ran in full ($SELECT empty, no base comparison: every red suite is newly red unless its rerun excused it as flaky) or its verdict was inherited.

inherited.description: With --whole --if-changed: the cache key (tree, or the cwd folder's tree) whose --whole run's verdict this tier reports again without running; null when the tier ran.

reused.description: Never under --whole: the cache key (tree, or the cwd folder's tree) where a pass measured in place (a compared run's candidate, or a whole run), with every base.copy input declared now and a selection covering this one (a whole run's for a whole run), is reused, so nothing ran; null otherwise. A fail is never reused.

command.description: The candidate's run with $REPORT and $SELECT resolved (batched: its first batch's); null when nothing ran.

reason.description: fail is timeout when every newly red suite is a fail whose every failure's first line reads TimeoutException, timed out or Exceeded timeout (a test failure still), else assertion. A not-run carries the candidate's reason, or the reason a batch did not finish when every red suite is carried; or vacuous when nothing could run (the cwd is missing, the tests glob matches no file); or empty-scope when nothing was selected and every import resolved, else unmeasured.

detail.description: Why a not-run tier measured nothing, when its reason alone does not say (cwd missing, a runner that died, selected files that never ran, unresolved imports); batched, the batch that did not finish first: batch <i>/<k> (<its first file>).

selection.description: The selected test files of a change-selected tier; null for a whole tier, a --whole run or an inherited verdict.

unresolved.description: The selection's unresolved imports; null for a whole tier, a --whole run or an inherited verdict.

unmapped.description: Changed files under the tier's cwd that the selection could map to no test; null for a whole tier, a --whole run, an inherited verdict, or when the selection does not report them.

candidate.description: null when nothing ran (empty-scope, unmeasured, a tier that could not start, or an inherited verdict). A reused pass is result pass with no suites, bounded and evidence null, and the record's counts when its selection equals this one, else null.

tests.description: Counts over every suite; null without a parsable report. An exit-code tier's counts are null (unknown). A timed-out side or batch adds counts only, never suites: its report read tolerantly (flutter-json: the tests that finished), else its log's last MM:SS +P ~S -F line.

suites.description: Only the red suites (fail or error).

truncated.description: Failures left out past the cap.

message.description: Why a suite that never ran its tests is error.

bounded.description: null for a reused pass. Batched: the bound of every batch, timed_out if any batch timed out, survivors summed (null if any is).

bound_minutes.description: The last attempt's bound: twice the declared one after a retry-2x, which a tier with select.batch_files never does.

survivors.description: Processes left in the tier's group, as the leader counted them.

batches.description: With select.batch_files, outside --whole: how many invocations a selection longer than it ran as.

missing.description: Selected files absent from the reports, which make the side vacuous (batched: when no red fails it first).

batches.description: With select.batch_files, outside --whole: each batch, a contiguous slice of the sorted selection (a whole_on run's: every test file), in the order run. Only a batch that finished gives suites.

base.description: null when nothing was compared: the candidate had no red suite, or the verdict was inherited or reused. A --whole run with a red suite has source none. inherited is a cached pass covering every red file, or a whole run's named fail that saw every base.copy input; a worktree base of a change-selected tier runs only the red files git holds at base (a whole tier's runs whole).

detail.description: Why the base measured nothing: the failed worktree add, a base.copy path that is tracked by any spelling or link, missing, or that cannot be copied ("copy: <path> is tracked", "copy: <path> missing", "copy: <path>: <error code>"), the prepare's exit, or, under --whole, that a whole run compares nothing. With source none and result pass, "no red file exists at base": every red file is new, so each is newly red against the base.

copied.description: The base.copy paths copied from the checkout into the worktree, links followed, before prepare.

basis.description: no-base when the base side is not-run, or the file's base batch did not finish.

reproduced.description: True when the flake rerun failed it again.

first_seen.description: The tree of the oldest cached record where this suite was red.

cleanup.description: The tier's cleanup after each timed-out attempt (a batch's under its side), each bounded by cleanup_minutes (default 1).
